title: Recognition of Experience of Ex-teachers who Rejoin Teaching Service
what_it_is: Recognition of Experience of Ex-teachers who Rejoin Teaching Service

sections.label: Rejoining teachers' remuneration package
sections.summary: MOE considers former teachers' relevant work experience and parity with peers when setting remuneration for those rejoining the Education Service.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: Seven of these officers had joined the Ministry after resigning from independent schools.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: Beyond these numbers, there were also other former teachers appointed on an adjunct capacity and who may subsequently be re-appointed to the Education Service.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: The Ministry of  Education (MOE) recognises the work experience and skills developed by teachers who leave the Education Service and rejoin thereafter.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: In determining the remuneration package of these former teachers, we take into consideration their relevant work experience after leaving service, as well as parity with their peers who had remained in service.

sections.label: Subject areas of greater need
sections.summary: The current approach attracts teachers and maintains capabilities, with greater need in Art, Music, Humanities, Physical Education and Tamil.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The current approach is effective at attracting teachers and maintaining capabilities.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: There are subject areas of greater need, specifically, Art, Music, Humanities, Physical Education and Tamil.

sections.label: Framework recognising returning officers' skills
sections.summary: A process takes into account work experience, personal qualities, content mastery and track records to recognise returning officers' skills.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: In terms of a framework to recognise the skills of the officers, the work experience, the personal qualities, the content mastery, the track records of these officers when in service are all taken into account.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: So, there is a process by which their relevant skills and work experience are recognised and valued as they come back into the Education Service.
